repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The name is not one a repository can have, is the one it has, or another repository has it.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The account logged in is not the repository's owner.

main.description: Moves the repository's dev.knotless.repo record to the new name, as `knotless repo rename` does, leaving a dev.knotless.redirect under the old one, so links and clones by it still lead there. Only its owner, logged in to this appview's web pages, can: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account, which the pages' session cookie names.

description: Gives a repository a new name.
